sections.title: Happyyyy birthdayyyyy Atene ❤️
paragraphs: OMGGGG ALMOST 3 YRRRSSS OF KNOWING EACH OTHERRRR.
LIKEE WHATTTT 😭😭

I genuinely don't even know where to startttt. It's actually crazy how we've known each other for this longggg. From meeting on Year 7 induction day to now, there's genuinely been SOOO much that's happened.
Like who would've thought that we'd end up becoming this close??? Definitely not me LMAOOOO.
Thank u genuinely for being the greatest hggg in the worlddd. I actually appreciate u smmmm, and I'm so glad I got to meet u.
We've had SO many random conversations, so many questionable moments, so many laughs and SO MANY things that I genuinely cannot explain to anyone else.
AND WE'RE STILL HEREEEEEE.
Rightttt, where do I even begin 😭

sections.title: The many jobs I have in ur life
paragraphs: I swearrrr I've got about 500 different positions in ur life at this point.
Homeboy, bsf, uncle, father, relationship advisor, unofficial therapist, personal detective, emotional support human, customer service AND GOD KNOWS WHAT ELSE.
LIKEE BROOOO WHAT AM I NOT???? 😭
I genuinely need a payslip for all this work. Where's my salary??? Where's my annual leave???
It okaying iggg bestayinggggg

sections.title: The Atene starter pack
paragraphs: I fear there's genuinely no explaining u to someone who doesn't know u 😭
Like where do I even begin???
The random yapping, the questionable decisions, the Roblox sessions, the conversations that somehow last forever, the things u say that genuinely leave me questioning everything.
And somehow, all of that is just NORMAL for u.
I don't think I'd even know what to do if u suddenly started acting completely normal. I'd probably assume something was wrong.
PLEASE NEVER BECOME BORING. I NEED THE ENTERTAINMENT.

sections.title: The Ali incident. Cough cough.
paragraphs: AHEHEHEHEHEHE.
We obviously cannot forget the Ali incident.
COUGH COUGH.
August was certainly an interesting timeeee 😭
I still don't even know how we ended up in that situation. The investigation, the messages, the questions, everythingggg.
We were genuinely acting like we had a whole detective agency to run.
And then there's Nathan and Mason, because apparently there's always SOMETHING happening.
I swearrrr if someone read through our conversations they'd probably be so confused.
Like what do u mean we're investigating this now???? WHY ARE WE EVEN HERE???? 😭
Honestly, Atene and Shri Investigations needs to become an actual business.

sections.title: Jackkkkk.
paragraphs: HOW COULD I FORGET JACK.
I still remember coming to ur house after school and getting the feeling that ur dog absolutely despised me.
LIKE WHAT DID I DOOOOO 😭
I literally came to visit and somehow felt like I was being questioned at the airport.
I don't think Jack and I have ever properly established a friendship.
Please tell him I said hi.
Actually, don't. He probably doesn't care.

sections.title: Robloxxxxxx.
paragraphs: BROOOOO.
THE AMOUNT OF ROBLOX WE'VE PLAYED IS ACTUALLY INSANE.
And obviously we HAVE to mention SLAP DUELS AND PISTOL ARENA.
LIKEEEEE.
The random fights, the competition, trying to get revenge, all the chaos and everythingggg.
I genuinely don't know how we manage to make every single session so chaotic.
We'll literally just be playing and somehow it turns into a whole situation 😭
And the funniest thing is that we keep coming back to play again.
I can't even lie, I think it's less about the actual games and more about the fact that we're playing together.
Even if we're doing absolutely nothing productive, somehow it's still entertaining.
And I already know we're gonna be doing the exact same thing in another few months.
Probably arguing over something on Roblox AGAIN.
Some things genuinely never changeeeee.

sections.title: Things that remind me of u.
paragraphs: It's actually funny how many random things can remind me of u now 😭
Certain Roblox games? Immediately think of u.
Something completely ridiculous happens? I already know I'd probably end up telling u about it.
Hear about some random drama? Suddenly I'm thinking about our investigations again.
See something that I know u'd find funny? Straight away, I wanna send it to u.
It's like my brain has somehow connected the most random things to u AHAHAHAHA.
And honestly, I wouldn't have it any other way.

sections.title: The late night yappingggg.
paragraphs: OMGGGG THE AMOUNT OF TIMES WE'VE JUST SAT THERE YAPPING IN THE MIDDLE OF THE NIGHT.
HOW DO WE EVEN DO IT???? 😭
We'll start talking about ONE thing and somehow end up on a completely different topic 20 minutes later.
And then there's those conversations where neither of us actually knows how we got there.
I genuinely love how random our conversations can be.
Whether we're talking about something serious, laughing over something stupid or just sending the most random messages ever, it's always entertaining.
And honestly, it's those little things that make our friendship what it is.

sections.title: Our friendship lore is actually insane.
paragraphs: BROOOOO, if our friendship had a timeline, I genuinely think we'd need an entire documentary.
2024: The beginning. Year 7. Absolutely no idea what was coming.
2025: More memories, more conversations, more random nonsense.
2026: Somehow nearly three years in, still yapping, still playing Roblox, still investigating things and still being absolute idiots.
And that's not even including all the individual incidents that deserve their own episodes.
The Ali incident alone needs a full documentary. COUGH COUGH.
I genuinely wonder what the next few years are gonna look like because at this rate, we're probably gonna have another 500 inside jokes by next birthday.
Honestly, Netflix needs to contact us. The amount of content we have is ridiculous.

sections.title: But seriously for a second.
paragraphs: I know I take the mick out of u A LOTTTT, but I genuinely do appreciate u.
Like more than I probably say.
I'm really glad I have someone I can just talk to about pretty much anything. Whether it's something serious or literally the most random thing ever, I know I can just be myself.
And I hope u feel the same way with me.
I genuinely want the best for u. I want to see u happy, doing well and achieving everything u want to achieve.
And I hope u know that whenever u need someone to talk to, I'm always willing to listen.
I might be annoying, I might yap too much, and I might make the most unnecessary jokes ever, BUT I DO CARE 😭
Thank u for being such an important part of my life.
And genuinely, I hope u never forget that.

sections.title: Things I actually appreciate about u ❤️
paragraphs: There's actually quite a lot I appreciate about u, even if I don't always say it.
I appreciate how I can just randomly message u and start yapping about absolutely anything.
I appreciate the fact that we can go from laughing about the most stupid thing ever to having a genuinely serious conversation.
I appreciate the times u check up on me, the times u listen and the little things u probably don't even realise I notice.
I appreciate how I can be completely myself around u without having to overthink everything.
And I appreciate that I have someone who's become such a big part of my everyday life.
I know I joke around A LOT, but I genuinely don't take any of that for granted.
And I hope u know that I appreciate the little things just as much as the big ones.

sections.title: Waitttt. 2024 us vs 2026 us.
paragraphs: NO BECAUSE THINK ABOUT IT.
We literally met on induction day in 2024.
YEAR 7.
And now we're here, nearly 3 years later.
I genuinely wonder what Year 7 us would've thought if someone told us everything that was gonna happen.
All the Roblox, the late night conversations, the investigations, the random drama, the school memories and everything else.
Like imagine explaining the Ali incident to ourselves back then.
WHAT WOULD WE EVEN SAY???? 😭
We've genuinely made so many memories since then, and it's crazy thinking about how much has changed.
And somehow, we're STILL doing the same ridiculous things.
I hope we can look back at all this in a few years and laugh at how stupid we were.
ALTHOUGH I DOUBT WE'LL BE ANY LESS STUPID BY THEN.
Here's to 2027, 2028 and MANY more years of this absolute nonsenseeeee.

sections.title: Our friendship subscription 💀
paragraphs: AHAHAHAHAHAHA.
I genuinely think our friendship subscription deserves its own explanation.
The free trial expires, somehow gets renewed, and then continues indefinitely.
I don't even think there's a cancellation option anymore.
LIKEE WHAT ARE THE TERMS AND CONDITIONS?????
But honestly, I hope that subscription keeps renewing for YEARS.
Automatic renewal ONNNNN.

sections.title: The official Atene awards 2026 🏆
paragraphs: AFTER EXTENSIVE RESEARCH, NUMEROUS INVESTIGATIONS AND ABSOLUTELY NO PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS, I AM PLEASED TO ANNOUNCE THE FOLLOWING AWARDS.
list: Most likely to get involved in random drama: ATENE.
Best person to yap to at ridiculous hours: ATENE.
Most likely to make me question my existence: ALSO ATENE.
Most likely to deny absolutely everything: ATENE.
Lifetime achievement award for putting up with me: ATENE.

sections.title: Potato muncher and vodka muncher.
paragraphs: I HAVE NO WORDS.
Absolutely no words.
The allegations are serious.
The suspect is known.
The investigation remains ongoing.
And I will not be taking any questions.
Thank u very much. 😭

sections.title: We actually need to hang out more.
paragraphs: BROOOOO.
HOW MANY TIMES HAVE WE SAID WE'RE GONNA HANG OUT AND THEN IT JUST DOESN'T HAPPEN?????
LIKE HELLOOOOO.
We need to actually start making plans and sticking to them.
I swear organising one hangout between us requires about 50 different business meetings.
But genuinely, I hope we get to do loads more together outside school.
More random days out, more memories and hopefully a lot less failed planning.
WE NEED TO SORT THIS OUTTTT.

sections.title: Things we still need to dooooo.
paragraphs: Rightttt, we have a LOT of unfinished business.
list: Have even more ridiculous Roblox sessions.
Find more things to laugh about.
Take more pictures and have things to look back on.
Somehow survive another year of our own nonsense.

sections.title: One more serious thingggg ❤️
paragraphs: I know I've already said this, but I genuinely hope u know u can always talk to me.
Doesn't matter what it is.
Something that's bothering u, something exciting, something random or just something u feel like talking about.
I'm always happy to listen.
And I hope u know that u don't have to pretend everything's okay around me.
I'll always want to see u doing well, and I'll always be rooting for u.
I might annoy u 24/7, but that's just part of the package I'm afraid.
NO REFUNDS. 😭

sections.title: A little message to future us.
paragraphs: I wonder where we'll both be in another few years.
What we'll be doing, what we'll have achieved, what new things we'll have experienced and what we'll be laughing about by then.
I hope we'll still remember all these little moments.
I hope we'll still be able to bring up some completely random incident from 2024 or 2025 and somehow spend another hour laughing about it.
And I hope that even when life gets busier and things change, we'll still find time to catch up and talk about absolutely everything.
I genuinely hope future us has even more memories to look back on than we do now.
PLEASE LET US STILL BE THIS CHAOTIC.

sections.title: Almost 3 years. Whatttt.
paragraphs: It's genuinely mad.
Almost three years of knowing each other, and we've somehow managed to collect this many memories and inside jokes.
I honestly wouldn't have expected any of this when we first met.
And I'm really glad things turned out the way they did.
I hope we have SOOO many more years of friendship, more random conversations, more Roblox, more memories and obviously more questionable investigations.
I don't want this to be one of those friendships where we just forget about everything after a while.
I genuinely hope we stay in each other's lives for a longggg time.
AND PLEASEEEE, WE NEED MORE MEMORIES TO ADD TO THIS ALREADY MASSIVE COLLECTION.

sections.title: Anywayyyyy, it's ur birthdayyyyy!!
paragraphs: ALSOOOOO I HOPE U LOVE UR NEW PLUSHIEEE AND THE PACKS OF DONUTSSSS.
I GENUINELY HOPE U LIKE THEM 😭❤️
The plushie has officially joined the household, and the donuts probably won't last very long AHAHAHAHA.
BUT SERIOUSLYYYYY.
I hope u have the best birthday everrrrr.
Enjoy ur day, have fun, eat lots and just have a lovely time.
U deserve ittttt.

paragraphs: I could genuinely keep writing for another 20 pages, but I think I've probably said enough at this point 😭
Thank u for everythingggg.
Thank u for all the laughs, the random yapping, the Roblox sessions, the memories, the investigations and all the little moments in between.
Thank u for being my hggg.
I appreciate u more than u probably realise, and I'm genuinely so glad I met u.
ALMOST 3 YEARS DOWNNNN, AND MANY MANY MORE TO GOOOOOO.
HAPPYYYY BIRTHDAYYYYY ATENEEEEEE!!!!!
LOVE YOUUUUU HG ❤️

i da better uncle and fathering hehehehehe
